scenarios.task: Which city hosted the project kickoff?
How did the preferred report format change, and why?
Prepare for the project review using its location, current report preference, and lessons from earlier reviews.
Summarize every decision, preference and lesson across the entire project history for planning the next review.

corpus.text: The project kickoff was held in Bergen.
In January the report preference was a detailed slide deck.
In March the report preference changed to a concise written brief.
March feedback explained the report format change: slides hid decision context; written briefs made rationale easier to review.
The next project review will be held in Oslo.
Review lesson: circulate evidence and open decisions before the meeting so participants can inspect assumptions.
